Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: SparkForge marketplace voucher — request to route partner credit for PoC

Hi David,

Hope you're well — I'm Maya, Partnerships Lead at SparkForge. We're preparing a short PoC with AcmeAnalytics (pilot starts 9/20) and we have a marketplace voucher bucket we'd like to route to a Redwood trial so the customer can test in-region. We've attached the voucher export (sparkforge_voucher_export.csv) with the codes and expiration dates.

Quick asks:
- Can Redwood apply partner-sourced credits to a dedicated trial instance or do we need to route through the marketplace claim flow?
- What documentation/PO/recipient do you need from us to get credits wired to the pilot environment?
- Can we do a 30-day trial extension for this cohort if the voucher + trial overlap leads to an early expiry?

Attached: sparkforge_voucher_export.csv (CSV of voucher codes).

Happy to hop on a 15-min call if easier.

Thanks,
Maya Patel
Partnerships Lead | SparkForge
maya@sparkforge.io

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya@sparkforge.io>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SparkForge marketplace voucher — request to route partner credit for PoC

Maya — thanks for the export and the heads up. Short answers up front: we can route partner vouchers into a trial pool but we need a documented routing instruction from the partner (signed or emailed from the partner account owner) plus a billing contact for invoice/ledger reconciliation.

Next steps I recommend:
- Maya: confirm the exact voucher IDs you want applied and include the marketplace claim URL in your reply (for our finance team).
- SparkForge: provide a named billing contact + remit instructions (email is ok).
- Redwood (Laura + Priyom): we'll prepare the voucher-routing-template.xlsx and a brief ops checklist so the partner codes are consumed against the pilot tenant.

If a 30-day extension is needed we can approve case-by-case — please include the trial expiration dates in your next email.

Would Monday 9/13 at 9:30am PT work for a quick sync?

Attached: SLA-exception-request.pdf (required for short extension approval).

1) Please sign the routing confirmation via DocuSign here: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/embedded/xyz-approval (or reply with a short emailed authorization from the SparkForge billing contact).
2) Confirm which four SF-ACME codes you'd like consumed for AcmeAnalytics.
